name: Herzebrock-Clarholz (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Herzebrock-Clarholz (a white horse and a tree with a wavy bend on green).
history: Municipal flag of Herzebrock-Clarholz; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Herzebrock-Clarholz arms — horse, tree and wavy bend on green
